svg.title: ZipDepth BNPU
svg.desc: Relative inverse depth,input3 × 384 × 384,native unfused eval,global_mode=balanced. Shapes exclude batch.
svg.text: Relative inverse depth,input3 × 384 × 384,native unfused eval,global_mode=balanced. Shapes exclude batch.

g.text: High-resolution inputs come fromS3,S2,S1 andhalf-stem skip.
Both trained heads also read the32-channel half feature.
b andbnpu have different head parameters; no weight-free rewrite.
Public loaded models fuse QARep branches; this view is unfused.
Identity branch has no BatchNorm; downsample blocks omit it.
Both exchange paths read originalS3/S4, before either result is updated.
Both heads finish withReLU. They are separately trained checkpoint variants.
Both heads finish withReLU. They are separately trained checkpoint variants.

svg.text: Balanced mode includes strip pooling andGC context; it does not execute the optional full-mode global-token attention.

g.text: Source: libreyolo/models/zipdepth/nn.py and model.py. Revision a4d0ecc9e17f.
